BusinessContext.Description: Converts SWIFT MT940 (Customer Statement Message) to ISO 20022 camt.053.001.08 (BankToCustomerStatement). MT940 provides detailed account statement information to customers including opening/closing balances and individual transaction lines. camt.053 is the ISO 20022 equivalent with structured entry-level data.
BusinessContext.ApplicableDomains: Cash Management, Treasury Operations, Corporate Banking, Account Reconciliation

ComplianceRequirements.Regulation: SOX — Financial Controls and Statement Accuracy

Variable.name: MAX_REF_LENGTH
Variable.description: Maximum length of MT940 reference fields

Variable.name: OPENING_BALANCE_CODE
Variable.description: ISO 20022 balance type code for opening balance

Variable.name: CLOSING_BALANCE_CODE
Variable.description: ISO 20022 balance type code for closing balance

Variable.name: DEFAULT_TX_CODE
Variable.description: Default SWIFT transaction type code when not specified in field :61:

Field.Description: Unique reference of the statement message
Identification of the account being reported
Sequential statement number and optional page sequence
Debit/credit mark, date, currency and amount of opening balance
Individual transaction entry — value date, entry date, D/C mark, amount, transaction type, reference
Additional information about the preceding statement line
Debit/credit mark, date, currency and amount of closing balance
Funds available for immediate use, distinct from closing book balance
Funds available for value-dated future transactions — forward-looking available balance

Field.ExampleValue: Entry with Amt, CdtDbtInd, ValDt, BookgDt

General.BusinessRationale: Reference identifies both the overall message and the statement itself
General.AuditRequirement: Statement reference logged for reconciliation audit trail.
General.ComplianceRequirement: MsgId and Stmt/Id mandatory per camt.053 schema.
General.MigrationNote: MT940 field :20: fits within camt.053 Max35Text without truncation.

General.BusinessRationale: Mandatory camt.053 header field. No MT940 equivalent.
General.AuditRequirement: Conversion timestamp logged for SLA monitoring.
General.MigrationNote: Generated at conversion time, always UTC.

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: account_string = trim(MT.F25) if(isIBAN(account_string)) Acct.Id.IBAN = account_string if(!isIBAN(account_string)) Acct.Id.Othr.Id = account_string

General.ImpactIfFails: Statement for wrong account — reconciliation failure
General.BusinessRationale: Account identification is mandatory for statement reconciliation
General.AuditRequirement: Account ID logged. Retention: AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Account identification required per banking secrecy laws.
General.DataPrivacy: IBAN is financial PII. Must be masked in logs per GDPR Article 25.
General.MigrationNote: MT940 field :25: format identical to MT950. Same isIBAN() dispatch logic applies.

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: field_28c = trim(MT.F28C) if(contains(field_28c, "/")) stmt_num_str = substring_before(field_28c, "/") if(!contains(field_28c, "/")) stmt_num_str = field_28c Stmt.ElctrncSeqNb = to_integer(stmt_num_str)

General.ImpactIfFails: Statement sequence tracking broken — duplicate/missing statement detection fails
General.BusinessRationale: Statement number enables customers to detect missing statements in sequence
General.AuditRequirement: Statement sequence logged for gap detection.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Sequential statement numbering required for audit trail completeness.
General.MigrationNote: MT940 field :28C: format NNNNN/NN — only statement number component maps to ElctrncSeqNb (integer).

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: dc_mark = substring(MT.F60F, 1, 1) date_str = substring(MT.F60F, 2, 6) currency = substring(MT.F60F, 8, 3) amount_str = substring(MT.F60F, 11) Bal_OPBD.Tp.CdOrPrtry.Cd = OPENING_BALANCE_CODE Bal_OPBD.Amt = decimal(amount_str.replace(",",".")) Bal_OPBD.CdtDbtInd = (dc_mark == "C") ? "CRDT" : "DBIT" Bal_OPBD.Dt.Dt = expandCentury(date_str, "yyMMdd", CENTURY_CUTOFF_YEAR)

General.ImpactIfFails: Statement balance incorrect — accounting discrepancy for customer
General.BusinessRationale: Opening balance is the starting reference point for the statement period reconciliation
General.AuditRequirement: Balance amounts logged for SOX financial controls.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Accurate opening balance mandatory for statement completeness.
General.MigrationNote: MT940 balance format: 1!a(C/D) + 6!n(YYMMDD) + 3!a(CCY) + 15d(amount comma decimal). All components parsed and restructured into camt.053 Bal element.

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: Ntry.Amt = decimal(MT.F61.amount) Ntry.CdtDbtInd = (MT.F61.dcmark == "C" OR MT.F61.dcmark == "R") ? "CRDT" : "DBIT" Ntry.ValDt.Dt = expandCentury(MT.F61.date, "yyMMdd", CENTURY_CUTOFF_YEAR)

General.ImpactIfFails: Individual transaction line missing or incorrect in statement
General.BusinessRationale: Statement line is the most complex SWIFT field — parses to individual entry for detailed reconciliation
General.AuditRequirement: Each entry logged for transaction-level audit trail.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Complete transaction detail required for statement accuracy per SOX.
General.DataPrivacy: Transaction data may reference counterparties — treat as sensitive.
General.MigrationNote: MT940 field :61: contains value date, entry date, D/C mark, amount, transaction type code, reference all concatenated without delimiters — most complex SWIFT field to parse.

General.ImpactIfFails: Loss of transaction detail context — statement still processable
General.BusinessRationale: Additional information helps customer identify the purpose of each transaction
General.ComplianceRequirement: No specific regulatory requirement — best practice for customer transparency.
General.DataPrivacy: May contain personal references. Treat as sensitive.
General.MigrationNote: MT940 field :86: (max 390 chars, 6 lines) truncated to camt.053 Ustrd max 140 chars.

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: dc_mark = substring(MT.F62F, 1, 1) date_str = substring(MT.F62F, 2, 6) currency = substring(MT.F62F, 8, 3) amount_str = substring(MT.F62F, 11) Bal_CLBD.Tp.CdOrPrtry.Cd = CLOSING_BALANCE_CODE Bal_CLBD.Amt = decimal(amount_str.replace(",",".")) Bal_CLBD.CdtDbtInd = (dc_mark == "C") ? "CRDT" : "DBIT" Bal_CLBD.Dt.Dt = expandCentury(date_str, "yyMMdd", CENTURY_CUTOFF_YEAR)

Condition.ElseAction: LOG_WARNING "Balance continuity check failed" AND PROCEED

General.ImpactIfFails: Statement closing balance incorrect — accounting discrepancy, statement completeness verification fails
General.BusinessRationale: Closing balance mandatory for statement completeness verification, final balance for the period
General.AuditRequirement: Closing balance and continuity check result logged for SOX financial controls.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Closing balance mandatory for regulatory statement reporting.
General.MigrationNote: Same parsing logic as opening balance (MAPPING_05) but uses CLBD code. Balance continuity check validates opening + entries = closing.

Condition.Action: PROCESS if present, skip if null — field :64: is optional in MT940

General.ImpactIfFails: Available balance information missing — statement still valid since field is optional, but customer loses visibility into immediately usable funds versus booked balance.
General.BusinessRationale: Closing available balance distinguishes funds available for immediate use from the closing book balance (:62F:), which may include value-dated items not yet available. Important for cash management and overdraft avoidance.
General.PerformanceImpact: LOW (string parsing, same as other balance fields)
General.AuditRequirement: Available balance logged alongside closing balance for cash position audit trail.
General.ComplianceRequirement: No specific regulatory mandate — best practice for accurate liquidity reporting per Basel III intraday liquidity monitoring.
General.MigrationNote: Same parsing logic as opening/closing balance (MAPPING_05/MAPPING_08) but uses CLAV code and is optional (not all MT940 messages include field :64:).

Condition.Action: PROCESS if present, skip if null — field :65: is optional and repeatable in MT940

General.ImpactIfFails: Forward-looking liquidity projection missing — statement still valid since field is optional and rarely used.
General.BusinessRationale: Forward available balance projects funds availability for a future value date, accounting for known future-dated transactions. Used by treasury for cash flow forecasting.
General.PerformanceImpact: LOW (string parsing, same as other balance fields)
General.AuditRequirement: Forward balance logged when present for liquidity forecasting audit trail.
General.ComplianceRequirement: No specific regulatory mandate — supports Basel III intraday liquidity monitoring (BCBS 248) forward-looking cash projections.
General.MigrationNote: Field :65: is optional and can repeat multiple times in a single MT940 for different forward value dates — this mapping handles the general case; multiple occurrences produce multiple FWAV Bal elements in camt.053.
